items.title: Drug company backdown sees lifesaving cancer treatment offered for free
items.description: Breast cancer patients were considering removing their ovaries until the maker of Zoladex 3.6mg said they would give the drug away rather than list it on the PBS.

items.title: Leaked Liberal document shows dead, ex-members tapped as preselectors
items.description: A leaked Liberal Party spreadsheet has revealed that one dead person and two ex-members were registered as preselectors for a vote in a key seat for the upcoming Victorian election.

items.title: Trump vows to retaliate 'hard' against Iran in expletive-laden warning
items.description: In a phone interview with Fox News, the US president reportedly said the US would "beat the f****** s***" out of Iran in response to the surprise strikes.

items.title: Queenslander could face execution over alleged killing of Australian in Syria
items.description: A 20-year-old Gold Coast mobile phone technician is facing a possible death penalty in Syria for the alleged shooting murder of another Australian.

items.title: New data shows Indigenous children face lengthy periods on remand
items.description: New data shows First Nations children are spending longer behind bars without a sentence. Families and experts say the system is failing young people.

items.title: Live: Young Aussie stuns from lane one as Dolphins make history in Glasgow
items.description: Australia claims its 29th gold in the pool in Glasgow, setting a new Commonwealth Games record. Follow live.

items.title: Three dead in Sydney house fire as police launch investigation
items.description: An investigation is now underway into the circumstances surrounding the fire.

items.title: How a wealth management firm swindled older Australians
items.description: Everyday Australians who invested their retirement savings and inheritances with a wealth management company fear they have lost everything after the company's licence was cancelled for selling bank bonds that didn’t exist.

items.title: More earthquake warnings in Japan as rescuers race to free those trapped
items.description: Earthquake warning alarms sounded on phones in the Kumamoto region again on Wednesday night when a 5.8 magnitude quake hit.

items.title: 'Time-limited rotation': Conroy puts an end date on US subs in WA
items.description: AUKUS submarines rotating through Western Australia's HMAS Stirling naval base appear set to stop after 2032.

items.title: Oscar-winning Irish musician Glen Hansard dies in motorcycle crash
items.description: Glen Hansard, best known for his role in The Commitments and as the frontman of The Frames, has died.

items.title: Inflation softer than expected in June but still 'uncomfortably high'
items.description: Headline inflation was softer than expected in June, but the RBA could still debate what to do with interest rates next month.

items.title: Norwegian teen guilty of UK murder plot tied to Iran-linked group
items.description: Police arrest the teen just two days before the planned hit on an unidentified person, after he arrived in the UK on an emergency passport.

items.title: Two firefighters die in Greece as Europe's wildfire emergency worsens
items.description: Emergency crews have been tackling wildfires four times the size of Paris in south-west France.

items.title: Shifting political views don't need to spell the end of a relationship
items.description: But experts say if morals are involved, it might be a relationship "deal breaker".

items.title: Quiz: Australian musician or Australian Rules footballer?
items.description: Footy and music are two of our most beloved pastimes. How well do you know the stars of each discipline?

items.title: Six artworks to see at the newly reopened Brett Whiteley Studio
items.description: An Archibald winner, an intimate portrait of a marriage and a suburban backyard are among the Brett Whiteley artworks on display at his renovated studio.

items.title: Drone captures rare video of 'magical moment' whale birth
items.description: A drone operator has captured video of a humpback whale giving birth, one of only a handful of people to film the phenomenon.

items.title: Russia charges Telegram founder with aiding terrorism
items.description: Russia has charged Pavel Durov, the founder and CEO of the encrypted messaging platform Telegram, with aiding terrorism, placing him on an international wanted list.

items.title: Staffer to whom Brittany Higgins first confided rape allegation settles case
items.description: A former political staffer has settled a contentious lawsuit with the Commonwealth over claims her workplace rights were compromised in the fallout of Brittany Higgins's rape allegation.

items.title: Cult inquiry recommends outlawing coercive control in groups
items.description: A Victorian inquiry into the recruitment methods and impacts of cults and organised fringe groups is recommending world-leading laws against group coercive control.

items.title: Mother attended police station day before murder-suicide, search for baby called off
items.description: The mother at the centre of the horrific murder-suicide in South Australia's South East attended a police station the day before she and her daughter were found dead, police have confirmed.

items.title: Woman born after IVF error hopes for change after legal action launched
items.description: The biological parents of twins who were born after an IVF embryo mix-up at Royal North Shore Hospital in Sydney have launched civil action.

items.title: Local transmission of H5 bird flu confirmed in Australia
items.description: Federal agriculture minister Julie Collins says "local transmission has occurred" between greater crested terns infected with H5 bird flu in South Australia.

items.title: NT Aboriginal groups accuse CLP of 'weaponising' Closing the Gap funding
items.description: Aboriginal groups have renewed calls for the Commonwealth to overhaul its funding arrangements with the Northern Territory government, accusing the Country Liberal Party of "weaponising" federal Indigenous disadvantage funding against Aboriginal Territorians.
